name: submit_group_membership_change
description: submit_group_membership_change: Submit a request to add or remove an employee from an access group. If the group requires approval, the request is created in pending state and the response includes both a case ID and a request ID for approval routing. Returns group_not_eligible if the employee's department or role does not meet the group's eligibility restrictions.

employee_id.description: The employee whose membership is being changed (e.g. EMP048271).

action.description: Whether to add the employee to or remove them from the group.
